Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we can lock an orientation/demo with the right folks: 

What we heard
- Need predictable inference latency for customer-facing features (sub-200ms for 95th).
- Concerned about cost per token at scale and multi-tenant security boundaries.
- Priorities: SSO, audit logs retention, and a low-friction pilot path.

Proposed next step
We recommend a 30-minute orientation + technical touchpoint where Ben (our infra SME) covers deployment patterns and SSO/audit details. Please pick the best slot for your team (PDT):
- Option A: Tue Aug 4 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
- Option B: Wed Aug 5 — 02:00–02:30 PM PDT
- Option C: Thu Aug 6 — 09:00–09:30 AM PDT

Can you confirm who will attend from Plenum.ai? From the discovery you mentioned a technical lead and a security/infrastructure owner — we can tailor the agenda once I have names.

I attached a short discovery recap and a draft mutual action plan to this thread. If any of the times don't work, tell me two windows that do and we'll re-propose.

Attachments: 20260722-discovery-recap.pdf, plenum-map-v1.xlsx

Next steps:
- Confirm attendee names and preferred option above.
- I’ll send a calendar invite with a proposed 20-minute infra deep dive + 10-minute Q&A.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.
